$comment: Where each shipped profile's executable lives. A profile belongs in the repository of the caller that owns its predicate, so two of the four are in sibling checkouts; the runner reports a missing sibling as SKIPPED rather than silently running a smaller suite. ${BELAY}/${PORTAGE} override with BELAY_DIR/PORTAGE_DIR; ${BELAY_PYTHON} resolves Belay's checked-in virtualenv interpreter, whose shebang is stale after the repo move.
